reason.dashboard__value__nothing_planned: Not applicable: nothing is planned to date.

reason.dashboard__kpi__no_period_in_window: Unknown: no reporting period falls in the selected window.
reason.benefit__value_amount_missing: Unknown: a value amount is missing.
reason.benefit__cost_amount_missing: Unknown: a cost amount is missing.
reason.benefit__overlap_open: Unknown: an overlap with another benefit is still open, so the value is held back.
reason.benefit__non_financial: Not applicable: a non-financial benefit has no money value.
reason.benefit__not_counted: Not counted: this benefit is counted through another record.
reason.kpi__no_accepted_actual: Unknown: no accepted actual for this period.
reason.kpi__no_active_version: Unknown: the KPI has no active version.
reason.kpi__no_approved_trajectory: Unknown: the KPI has no approved trajectory.
reason.kpi__before_trajectory: Unknown: the period is before the trajectory starts.
reason.kpi__stale: Stale: the latest actual is older than the KPI's frequency allows.
reason.kpi__rag__no_actual: Unknown: no actual to compare with the trajectory.
reason.kpi__rag__before_trajectory: Unknown: the period is before the trajectory starts.
reason.kpi__rag__not_computable: Not computable: the status cannot be calculated from the data.
reason.other: Reason not listed in this release.

ragPolicy.title: Dashboard RAG policy
ragPolicy.intro: The thresholds behind each Template 10 area's status. Empty fields use the default values.

ragPolicy.notConfigured: Not configured yet: the default thresholds apply. The first save creates the policy.
ragPolicy.readOnly: Read-only view: changing the policy needs the dashboard-configuration permission (Transformation Office or KPI data steward).
ragPolicy.thresholdsIntro: Ratios are decimal fractions from 0 to 1 (0.05 = 5%); days are working days of the organization's calendar. An amber threshold cannot be beyond its red threshold.
